messages:
Sam: Heads-up 10x HelioSys PoC wants a hosted burst next Thu 08:30-09:10 PT to run a client harness (approx 180 clients, ~7 rps each). Can we get a scoped key + temporary quota bump and IP allowlist? Org: org-helio-99.
Priya: What endpoint/model + avg tokens? Need to size tokens/min.
Sam: Hitting /v1/generate, model redwood-2.0-large. Avg end-to-end ~400 tokens. Ballpark = 180 * 7 * 400 = 504k tokens/min peak. Asking for 650k/min to be safe over a 30m test window.
Marco: That be ~10.8k tokens/sec. us-west-2 pool has headroom if we reserve. Recommend token_quota_per_minute=650000, concurrent cap=250, and a 40m valid window (10m pad). Need exact UTC times.
Priya: Security ask: scoped key only, IP allowlist mandatory, redact prompt fields in logs for this key, set retention 5d, and disable external audit export for temp keys. Also need a primary contact.
Sam: Contact is wendy@helio.chat. I like graceful fallback rather than hard 429s. Can we route to a quantized variant if saturated?
Marco: We can add routing_policy -> fallback_model: redwood-1.3-small and add response header X-RW-Model to indicate which model served the request. Sample admin create call I run after IPs: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"org_id":"org-helio-99","name":"helio-poc-burst","scopes":["gen:invoke"],"token_quota_per_minute":"650000","concurrent_request_limit":"250","valid_window":"2026-06-18T15:20:00Z/2026-06-18T16:00:00Z","routing_policy":{"fallback_model":"redwood-1.3-small","response_header":"X-RW-Model"}}'
```
ops-bot: INFRA ACTION: reserved capacity on pool us-west-2 for tag "helio-poc-burst" 100 rps equivalent 1 ticket INF-5054
Marco: I also attach an alert: page if 5xx > 1% for 3m OR median latency > 550ms. We'll auto-throttle the key if cross-customer impact detected.
Priya: Once IP allowlist and contact confirmed I mark security sign-off. Logs masked for prompt_text, user_id; retention set to 5 days.
Sam: IPs sent in DM. Thanks team 1 I need the scoped key + instructions to rotate if anything goes wrong.
Marco: Scoped key created: sk_helio_poc_1967. Token quota=650000/min, concurrent cap=250, retention=5d, fallback configured. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/poc/helio-1967.
Sam: Great 1 I appreciate live monitor during the window. Will post post-test metrics and any anomalies. Thanks all :raised_hands:
